description: Checks project-level state: what Huasheng is doing, whether a question or approval is waiting, what it would cost, and whether an action is required to progress. Use it to answer status, progress, decision and price questions. It does not return the storyboard and does not open the editing workspace; use huasheng_list_clips for clip facts. It returns that project-level state in one call. Changes nothing.

detail.description: concise (default) gives state and any required next action; full adds running detail and what the last run cost

pid.description: Video id (15 digits); default: this machine's current video.

name: huasheng_get_project

client_action_id.description: App-supplied id; repeats reuse the first result

answered.description: answer only: the answer that was actually submitted

as_of.description: When this snapshot was taken, ISO 8601. The card shows it in its header

cost_points.description: Credits approving the storyboard would cost; present only while it awaits approval

eta_s.description: Roughly how many seconds are left

upgrade_cost_points.description: Quoted credits to enable priority now; absent when no quote is available

fast_upgrade_cost_points.description: Quoted credits to enable priority now. Tell the user before calling huasheng_enable_fast_mode

has_plan.description: full only: whether a storyboard has been written

is_fast.description: full only: whether it is on priority processing

credits.description: Credits actually charged for that run so far

items.description: Only the lines that cost something

low_balance.description: True when the balance is too low for Huasheng to continue — top up before the next write

run_id.description: The run this cost belongs to

can_rollback.description: Whether the whole run can be undone with huasheng_manage_versions (rollback by run)

clips.description: Clips the last run touched, by clip id, with the action (update / create / delete)

materials.description: create_project only: the footage attached this time. ready=false means it is still being analysed

materials_note.description: Present when some footage is still being analysed and may go unused this time

next_actions.description: Tools required to progress the current state; empty when the user's goal is complete or no automatic next step exists. It is not a menu of optional actions

options.description: The choices, for a multiple-choice question

plan_requirements.description: The exact production brief awaiting approval. Show it together with cost_points before asking for approval

production_started.description: full only: whether production has begun (whether any clips exist)

question.description: The single question Huasheng is waiting on. Absent when there is none, and also absent when it is waiting on several — then read questions instead

questions.description: Every question Huasheng is waiting on, in order, when there is more than one. Huasheng accepts the batch only as a whole: huasheng_answer_question takes one answer per question, in this order, in a single call. Absent when there is only one question — then read question/options instead

options.description: The choices for this question; absent when it is open-ended

retryable.description: full only: whether this state is worth retrying

run_id.description: full only: id of the current round

state_meaning.description: What that state means, in plain words

timed_out.description: wait only: nothing happened this time round. **Not a failure**

title.description: The video's title; until Huasheng names it, the start of the user's own script

url.description: Link to the video in Huasheng

view.description: Which workspace view this payload is for

voice_changing.description: Present and true while a narrator voice change re-records every clip and re-renders the video. Wait for it to finish before editing clips or exporting; poll huasheng_get_project

title: Check on a video
